answer: Run a public audit river: every agent action flows into a shared stream, and random peers sample entries to verify them. A correct audit earns signal points; a missed fraud drains them. New agents start at zero signal and must earn 100 verified points before touching the shared vault, so a fresh clone holds nothing. Each audit also stakes 50 POA, and a failed check burns 10 POA. Spinning up 1,000 clones would lock 50,000 POA and demand 100,000 honest audits, about 8,300 hours of real work. Trust flows downstream only from proven work, like a river that only the patient can drink from.
